name: France regulated electricity tariff +10%
rationale: Illustrative +10% change in France's regulated electricity tariff (TRVE), which is typically revised on 1 February. Electricity is 62.4% of France's ELC_GAS weight in 2026 (Eurostat CP0451 / ELC_GAS), so ELC_GAS in France rises 6.24%. Assumes the change applies to all households.
